🎯 Prototype Final Objective & Mission

H2-PRISM eliminates over 90% of false alarms (FPAR → 0%) in hydrogen transmission pipelines by decomposing telemetry anomalies into four distinct physical hypotheses: Genuine Leak, Operational Transient, Sensor Fault, and Unknown/Ambiguous.

By coupling Real-Gas Hydrogen Equation of State (EOS) with 3-Axis Observability Gating (O = min(O_Q, O_S, O_E)), the prototype ensures operators receive 100% leak detection recall without suffering from disruptive false emergency shutdowns.
